modmenu.summaryTranslation.jukz: Play with friends in the same world, with no server.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.jukz: Open a world and your friends can jump in: no server, no port forwarding. When the host leaves, someone else takes over; when everyone leaves, the world waits in the cloud. Also: your worlds on every PC with a Microsoft account, and free cosmetics. The Config button opens your jukz account.
